title: Turkish Vegetable Stew
subtitle: in a garlicky tomato sauce
description: Cubes of potato, eggplant and zucchini are fried, then simmered with tomatoes and garlic into one big happy stew.

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and part-peel the eggplant in stripes. Cut the potatoes, eggplant and zucchini into cubes and dry them well with paper towel.
Fry each vegetable separately until golden, then remove and set aside.
Fry the chopped onion until soft and lightly golden. Add the crushed garlic and fry for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato paste and fry for another 1-2 minutes.
Grate or blend the tomatoes and add them with the chilli flakes, salt and black pepper. Cook for a few minutes until a sauce forms.
Add the fried vegetables and stir gently. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10-15 minutes.
